rule.name: daily_living_tv_close
rule.description: DL-M04 companion to daily_living_tv_open. Closes the open watching_tv ActivitySession once the TV is off, OR the resident has been in a different room for at least idle_close_minutes (daily_living.tv.idle_close_minutes; the '10' literal in this rule's condition mirrors that setting -- update both together if changed). The absence check approximates 'time since left the TV room' as 'dwell in whatever OTHER room she is currently in', since presence_query only reports dwell in the current room; see the dated M00 correction for why this is an accepted approximation rather than a new step. PLACEHOLDERS: __RESIDENT_PERSON_ID__, __TV_ROOM_NAME__, __TV_MEDIA_PLAYER_ENTITY__.
